display_name: Necessary-good (x1) demand curves under four micro-foundations

triage.reason: Renderable multi-trace demand curve (Shaikh Fig 3.10): one analytic curve plus four NetLogo agent-based simulation curves for the necessary good, on shared price-quantity axes (5 subseries x 51 points = 255 rows, all non-null). Renders as overlaid x-y demand curves (x = aggregate x1 quantity, carried in the 'year' index column 1-9, NOT calendar years). TRIAGE_PRESCREEN EMPTY flag is STALE: L01_S308/P02_S308 exist and replicate.py --series S308 builds the chopped (PASS, 255 rows). content_type theoretical, construction composite (analytic + simulation). KB gap: ch03 not HDARP-extracted, so the ch3 figure quotes are unverifiable and 'From the book' is omitted.
